integrity: All proofs and assumptions are supplied; finite checks supplement rather than substitute for proof. The earliest initiating publication is the original public arXiv submission, not its revision.
limitations: The explicit all-dimensional formula and knot jumps are proved; only dimension three has a full extremum classification. The paper does not prove a new general Mahler lower bound. Possible earlier expression in symmetric-norm language is not excluded. Independent audit not performed.
title: Exact Mahler products for cube–cross-polytope intersections and their three-dimensional phase diagram
